notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. DIT symbol sheet (Symbol Series: a sign component published as its own drawing; used on service, tourist and warning signs at the percentage each sign sheet states). Sheet S138 (interstate bus terminal): bus 10 / 400 / 10, 50 from the top; ADELAIDE '50 DN' (372 wide) baseline 325. Layout: 420 x 350, blue, R0, no border. Legend placed from the sheet's own filled artwork measured at 1200 dpi (letter heights from the ink, series confirmed by the FHWA widths, each word centred on its ink; the sheet's dimension chains were not transcribed one by one for this sign — the positions are the sheet's drawn artwork itself, which the overlay check confirms): symbol bus side view with INTERSTATE cut out in blue (400 x 160) x 21-400 y 62-198; ADELAIDE 50 E white top 275 x 26-396 (370).
